item.title: Psychiatric care, not prison, for man who killed 11-year-old in Nieuwegein
item.description: The court has sentenced Hamzah L., who killed 11-year-old Sohani in Nieuwegein last year, to compulsory psychiatric care at a TBS facility.

item.title: Video shows guard making asylum seeker kiss his shoes at Dutch shelter
item.description: A video has surfaced in which a guard at the asylum seekers’ shelter in Budel, Noord-Brabant, forces an asylum seeker to kiss his shoes.

item.title: Museum discovers last living Engelandvaarder, aged 102
item.description: The Museum Engelandvaarders has uncovered a remarkable find: a 102-year-old Engelandvaarder is still alive.

item.title: Palestinians with Dutch visas ask Netherlands to help evacuate them from Gaza
item.description: Three Palestinians holding valid visas for the Netherlands are seeking urgent government help to leave Gaza, citing ongoing Israeli attacks and severe humanitarian conditions.

item.title: Port of Rotterdam to monitor drones more closely, invests in detection systems
item.description: The Port of Rotterdam will increase surveillance of drones in its airspace this year.

item.title: Code red for black ice in northern Netherlands; NL Alert to stay off the roads
item.description: Black ice is causing extremely treacherous conditions in the northern parts of the Netherlands. The KNMI issued a code red weather alarm for Groningen, Friesland, and Drenthe.
